div.head: IV Atr 2.11
div.ab: De dosseris cum gallinis I gallina telon., et de uno dossero cum ouis V oua telonei, si ueniant ad mercatum.
De dosseris cum gallinis I gallina telonei, et de uno dossero cum ovis V ova telonei, si veniant ad mercatum.
From hampers with hens, one hen [is given] as toll, and from one hamper of eggs, five eggs as toll, if they come to the market.
Von Tragekörben mit Hühnern: je 1 Huhn Zoll, und von je einem Tragekorb mit Eiern 5 Eier Zoll, wenn sie zu Markte kommen.
From panniers with hens: 1 hen as toll each, and from each pannier with eggs 5 eggs as toll, if they come to market.
